name: dynamic collection slots retain arbitrary keys and values
source: function main(): void { const map = new Map<number, number>(); const set = new Set<number>(); const m: any = map; const s: any = set; const original: any = new Function("return {x: 7}")(); m.set("key", original); s.add(original); console.log(map.size, m.get("key") === original, s.has(original), set.size); original.x = 9; console.log(m.get("key").x); }
